title: Asahina Mafuyu — Delayed Reunion〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh! Hey, Mafuyu!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, where's Kanade?
I thought you two came here together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She went to that shop over there to retrieve a CD she ordered.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, I'm glad I made it here in time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I woke up just an hour before I had to leave my house. You should've seen the panic I was in while I got ready.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks to that, I was only able to have a slice of bread before coming here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Were you that hungry...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I feel that you could've skipped that to give yourself more time, since we're having our after-party at the diner.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, but I've been craving pancakes today. I didn't want dessert to be the first thing I ate on an empty stomach.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But at the same time, I'm not sure I'd be able to handle pancakes if I had a full meal at the diner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't comment since I've never found myself in that sort of situation.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Let's ask Kanade and Ena about this when they get here!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, I think Ena's gonna agree with me, while Kanade says more or less the same thing as you!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just remembered something I said to you before.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember when I talked to you about how scary it is to think you won't be accepted?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I remember.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're afraid that he won't understand...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially since he's someone really important to you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The thought of possibly being rejected after telling him everything is just so terrifying...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which makes you think, why bother telling him at all?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's probably why I became stuck for so long too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'm starting to think that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There are more people who will accept me for who I am than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, I really put myself on a pedestal there. I mean, the things I said and the way I talked.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
To be honest...
That was sorta also meant for me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because I care so much about myself, I'm really scared of being hurt or rejected...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, why did you tell me all that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you don't like being hurt, then it must've been hard for you to talk about those things.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And yet, you did. Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
...
It's because of something Luka said a little while back...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She said that I could help you because I was a coward who'd been running from everything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I agreed with her then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I couldn't just leave you be, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Does this mean you're done running?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Dunno...
I really wanna stop...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially since certain people came chasing after me like there was no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That also must've been hard.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha...
Well, that was sort of a first for me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The thing is, I asked Ena to wait until I was ready to talk.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But she ended up finding out before I got to, and then I ran away...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, who wouldn't come chasing after me in that situation?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She didn't stop complaining for a while after that day. She blames you for making her eyes hurt after crying so much, her losing her voice and being sore from running around...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When I saw her chasing after me, I really didn't want her to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I actually hoped that she'd give up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But looking back, I feel really happy knowing that I have a friend who's willing to do that for me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: At the very least, I'm not running again from Ena or N25... I don't want to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Just, well...
Go easy on me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, there's Kanade!
Hey!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Ena as well.
She seems sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...? Haha. Look at that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, we gotta ask them about having dessert on an empty stomach!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You remembered...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Kanade! Ena! Over here!
